instagram.metaTitle: Instagram Reels Downloader - Download Video HD Free
instagram.metaDescription: Free Instagram Reels downloader. Paste a Reel, video or post link and save it as an MP4 to your phone or computer. No login, no app, no signup.
instagram.lead: Paste the link of any public Instagram Reel, video post or IGTV video and save it as an MP4 in seconds. It works on iPhone, Android and desktop, with no login and nothing to install.
instagram.copyHint: In the Instagram app, open the Reel, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Can I download Instagram Reels from a private account?
faq.a: No. Only public posts can be downloaded. Private accounts restrict their content to approved followers, and this tool never asks for your Instagram login.

faq.q: Which Instagram links work?
faq.a: Reel links (instagram.com/reel/…), video posts (/p/…), IGTV (/tv/…) and Instagram share links. Posts that only contain photos have no video to save.

faq.q: Why is my downloaded Instagram video silent?
faq.a: Some clips are posted without sound, and Instagram sometimes delivers video and audio as separate files. When only a video-only file is available we tell you, and if a separate audio track is offered you can save it with the audio button.

youtube.metaTitle: YouTube Video Downloader - Download Shorts & MP4 HD Free
youtube.metaDescription: Download YouTube Shorts and videos as MP4 for free. Paste a youtube.com or youtu.be link and save it with sound. No login, no software.
youtube.lead: Paste a YouTube Shorts or video link (youtube.com or youtu.be) and save it as an MP4 with sound. It's free, needs no account and works in any browser.
youtube.copyHint: In the YouTube app, tap Share, then Copy link. On a computer, copy the address from your browser.

faq.q: What quality do I get when downloading from YouTube?
faq.a: You get a single MP4 file with sound. YouTube normally offers those ready-made files at up to 360p; higher resolutions are delivered as separate video and audio streams that can't be combined here, so 360p is the practical ceiling for now.

faq.q: Can I download YouTube Shorts?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the Shorts link (youtube.com/shorts/…) or the share link and it downloads like any other video.

faq.q: Can I download age-restricted or private YouTube videos?
faq.a: No. Those need a signed-in YouTube account, which this tool never uses. Public videos work; private, members-only and age-restricted ones don't.

facebook.metaTitle: Facebook Video Downloader - Download Video HD Free
facebook.metaDescription: Free Facebook video downloader. Paste a Facebook video, Reel or fb.watch link and save it as an MP4. No login, no app to install.
facebook.lead: Paste a public Facebook video, Reel or fb.watch link and save it as an MP4. It works on phones and computers, and you don't need to sign in to anything.
facebook.copyHint: Tap Share under the video, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which Facebook links are supported?
faq.a: Video links (facebook.com/watch and /videos/), Reels (/reel/), Facebook share links and fb.watch short links. Photos and text posts have no video to download.

faq.q: Can I download videos from private groups or friends-only posts?
faq.a: No. Only public videos can be fetched. Content limited to friends or group members requires a Facebook login, which this tool doesn't use.

faq.q: Why did my Facebook link fail?
faq.a: The video is probably not public, has been deleted, or is restricted in some regions. Check that it opens in a private browser window without logging in; if it does, try again in a minute.

threads.metaTitle: Threads Video Downloader - Download Video HD Free
threads.metaDescription: Download videos from Threads posts as MP4 for free. Paste a threads.net or threads.com link. No login, no app needed.
threads.lead: Paste the link of a public Threads post with a video and save it as an MP4. Both threads.net and threads.com links work, and there's nothing to install.
threads.copyHint: Tap the Share icon on the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Do threads.com and threads.net links both work?
faq.a: Yes. Threads uses both domains, and links from either one are accepted, including the share links the app creates.

faq.q: Can I download photos from Threads?
faq.a: This tool saves videos. A post that only contains photos or text has no video, so there is nothing to download.

faq.q: Why doesn't my Threads link work?
faq.a: Threads support is newer and depends on what Threads publicly shows for a post. Posts from private profiles, or without a video, can't be downloaded; if a public video fails, try again later.

x.metaTitle: Twitter Video Downloader - Download X Video HD Free
x.metaDescription: Download Twitter and X videos as MP4 for free. Paste a post link from x.com or twitter.com. No login, no app.
x.lead: Paste the link of a public post on X (formerly Twitter) and save its video as an MP4. Both x.com and twitter.com links work, and no login is needed.
x.copyHint: Tap the Share icon under the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Do x.com and twitter.com links both work?
faq.a: Yes. Twitter is now X, and the old twitter.com links still point to the same posts, so both are accepted.

faq.q: Can I download GIFs from Twitter?
faq.a: Twitter stores GIFs as short MP4 videos, so GIF posts normally download as an MP4 file.

faq.q: What if a post has several videos?
faq.a: Each video is listed separately with its own Download button, and there's a Download all option.

pinterest.metaTitle: Pinterest Video Downloader - Download Video HD Free
pinterest.metaDescription: Free Pinterest video downloader. Paste a pin or pin.it link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
pinterest.lead: Paste the link of a Pinterest video pin and save it as an MP4 in seconds. Short pin.it links work too, and you never need to sign in.
pinterest.copyHint: Open the pin, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Does it work with pin.it short links?
faq.a: Yes. We follow the short link to the real pin automatically, so you can paste whatever the app gives you.

faq.q: Can I download image pins?
faq.a: No. This tool is for video pins. Image pins contain no video.

faq.q: Do country versions of Pinterest work?
faq.a: Yes. Links from pinterest.com and regional sites such as pinterest.co.uk or pinterest.fr are accepted.

tiktok.metaTitle: TikTok Video Downloader - Download Video HD Free
tiktok.metaDescription: Free TikTok video downloader. Paste a TikTok or vm.tiktok.com link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
tiktok.lead: Paste a public TikTok link and save the video as an MP4 in seconds. Short links from the TikTok app work too, and you don't need an account.
tiktok.copyHint: In TikTok, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which TikTok links work?
faq.a: Full links (tiktok.com/@user/video/…) and the short links the app creates (vm.tiktok.com and vt.tiktok.com), which we follow automatically.

faq.q: Can I download private or friends-only TikToks?
faq.a: No. Only public videos can be saved. Private videos require a TikTok login that this tool never asks for.

faq.q: Why does a TikTok link sometimes fail?
faq.a: TikTok limits automated requests, so a link can occasionally fail even though the video is public. Wait a minute and paste it again.

reddit.metaTitle: Reddit Video Downloader - Download Video HD Free
reddit.metaDescription: Download Reddit videos for free. Paste a Reddit post or v.redd.it link and save the MP4 and, when available, the audio track separately.
reddit.lead: Paste a link to a Reddit video post or a v.redd.it link and save the video as an MP4. No account or app is needed, and if Reddit provides a separate audio track you can save that too.
reddit.copyHint: Tap Share on the post, then Copy link.

faq.q: Why does my Reddit video have no sound?
faq.a: Reddit stores a video and its audio as two separate files, and this tool can't merge them. The MP4 you download is video-only; when Reddit offers the audio track you'll see a separate Download Audio button so you can save it too.

faq.q: Do v.redd.it and share links work?
faq.a: Yes. Post links (reddit.com/r/…/comments/…), share links (…/s/…) and v.redd.it links are all accepted.

faq.q: Can I download NSFW or private-subreddit videos?
faq.a: No. Those require a logged-in Reddit account, which this tool doesn't use. Public posts work.

snapchat.metaTitle: Snapchat Spotlight Downloader - Download Video HD Free
snapchat.metaDescription: Free Snapchat Spotlight downloader. Paste a public Spotlight link and save the video as an MP4. No login, no app.
snapchat.lead: Paste the link of a public Snapchat Spotlight video and save it as an MP4. Short links from the Snapchat app work too, and you don't need an account.
snapchat.copyHint: Open the Spotlight video, tap Share, then Copy link.

faq.q: Which Snapchat links are supported?
faq.a: Public Spotlight links (snapchat.com/spotlight/…) and the short links the app creates (t.snapchat.com). Stories and private snaps are not supported.

faq.q: Can I download someone's Snapchat Story?
faq.a: No. Stories aren't public Spotlight videos, and they're restricted to the people they're shared with. This tool works only with public Spotlight posts.

faq.q: Can I download private snaps?
faq.a: No. Private snaps are only visible to their recipients and can't be reached through a public link.

seo.heading: The fastest way to save social media videos
paragraphs: Most social platforms don't give you a built-in way to save someone else's video to your device. Our tool solves that in one paste: drop in the link from Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, X, Pinterest, TikTok, Reddit or Snapchat, and we fetch the video file so you get a clean MP4 you can watch offline.

It works entirely in your browser — there's nothing to install, no account to create, and no personal data required. Just the public link to the video you want. That makes it safe to use on any device, whether you're on a phone between classes or at a desktop editing a compilation.

Creators use it to archive their own content before it disappears from feeds, marketers use it to build swipe files of ad creative, and everyday users use it to keep a copy of a clip a friend sent them before it gets deleted. Whatever the reason, the flow stays the same: paste, preview, download.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What SaveReelsFast processes when you use it, how long temporary data is kept (up to 3 hours), that no media is stored, and your privacy choices.

sections.heading: Overview
body: SaveReelsFast (savereelsfast.com) is a free tool for saving publicly available videos from popular social platforms. You do not need an account, and we never ask for your social media username or password. This policy explains what information is processed when you use the site, how long it is kept, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: What we process
body: Links you submit: when you paste a video link, it is sent to our server, and to a backend service that runs on our behalf, so we can look up the public video.

Technical data: like most websites, our hosting providers may automatically record your IP address, browser type, device type and the time of each request for security, abuse prevention and reliability.
What we don't collect: we have no user accounts, we don't ask for your name or email to use the tool, and we don't build advertising profiles ourselves.

sections.heading: Temporary caching and retention
body: To make repeat requests fast and to protect the service from overload, the result of a link lookup (the link, the title, the thumbnail address and temporary download addresses) is kept in server memory for up to 3 hours and is then discarded automatically. It is never written to a database.
No media is stored. Videos and audio are streamed from the original platform through our servers to your device in real time and are not saved on our systems, not even temporarily on disk.
Server logs kept by our hosting providers are retained according to their own retention periods. Data stored in your browser (see below) stays on your device.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We set one functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember the language you choose. It contains no personal information and expires after one year.

Your browser's local and session storage holds a few convenience settings: your most recent results (cleared when you close the tab) and whether you dismissed the install banner or the sticky ad. This data never leaves your device, and you can clear it in your browser settings at any time.
We do not use analytics or tracking cookies of our own.

sections.heading: Advertising
body: SaveReelsFast is free to use because it may show advertisements. Ads are delivered by third-party advertising networks (for example Google AdSense or similar networks). These networks may set or read cookies and use identifiers such as your IP address to show ads, limit how often you see them and measure results.

The links you paste are never shared with advertisers. Ad networks receive only what your browser sends when it loads an ad. Where the law requires your consent for non-essential advertising cookies (for example in the EU, EEA and UK), it will be requested before such cookies are used.

You can manage ad personalization at adssettings.google.com or in your browser and device settings, and opt out of interest-based advertising at optout.aboutads.info (US) or youronlinechoices.eu (EU).

sections.heading: Third parties
body: Videos are retrieved from the public servers of the platform they come from (for example Instagram, YouTube or TikTok). We are not affiliated with these platforms, and their own privacy policies apply to their services.

For some YouTube videos, when we cannot retrieve the video directly, we may send that video's public YouTube ID to a third-party download service (an instance of the open-source Cobalt tool) to obtain the file. We send only that ID: no cookies, account details or other information about you. That service is run by a third party under its own terms.
Our site and backend service are hosted by third-party providers that process technical data on our behalf under their own privacy terms. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR, the UK GDPR, the CCPA/CPRA or Brazil's LGPD) you may have the right to access, correct or delete personal data, to object to or restrict its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw consent. We do not sell personal information.

Because we don't keep accounts or profiles, there is usually little data we can link to you. To make a request, contact us using the details on the Contact page and, if you can, include the approximate time of your visit. You can also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children
body: This service is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

sections.heading: International processing and security
body: Our providers may process data in the United States and in other countries. Where required by law, we rely on the appropriate safeguards those providers offer.
All traffic uses HTTPS and we keep data collection to a minimum. No system is perfectly secure, but not storing media or accounts limits what could ever be exposed.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

body: By using SaveReelsFast you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: The service
body: SaveReelsFast helps you download publicly available videos from supported social platforms to your own device. It works only with public content and does not bypass privacy settings, paywalls or logins.

sections.heading: Fair use and permitted use
body: The service is intended for personal, non-commercial use, such as watching offline or archiving your own work. Saving content you don't own may be allowed as fair use or under similar exceptions in some countries, but that depends on your local law and on how you use the file. Nothing in these terms grants you any rights in content owned by others.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
body: You are solely responsible for the links you submit and for what you do with downloaded content. Before downloading, make sure you have the right to save and use it. You agree to respect copyright, trademark, privacy and other rights, the terms of the platform the content comes from, and applicable laws.

sections.heading: Prohibited use
body: You may not use the service to break the law, infringe copyright or other rights, re-upload other people's content without permission, harass others, download content of minors in a harmful way, or overload or attempt to disrupt the service through automated or abusive requests.

sections.heading: Intellectual property and copyright
body: All videos, captions and images belong to their respective creators or rights holders. SaveReelsFast does not host, own or claim rights in any content you download. If you are a rights holder and believe content is being handled in a way that infringes your rights, see our DMCA page.

dmca.title: DMCA & Copyright Policy
dmca.description: How to report copyright infringement to SaveReelsFast. We host no video content; find the takedown procedure and our designated agent's contact details here.
dmca.intro: This page explains how copyright owners can report content and how SaveReelsFast responds. We respect intellectual property and follow the notice-and-takedown process of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512).

sections.heading: We do not host any content
body: SaveReelsFast is a tool, not a video library. We do not host, store, upload, index or make available any video, audio or image files on our servers. When you download something, the file is relayed in real time from the original platform's servers to your device and is not saved by us.

sections.heading: Report it at the source
body: Because the video stays on the original platform (for example Instagram, YouTube, TikTok or X), the most effective way to have infringing content removed is to report it to that platform through its own copyright tools. Once a video is removed there, it can no longer be downloaded through SaveReelsFast either.

sections.heading: What a takedown notice must include
body: To ask us to stop processing a specific link, send a written notice that contains all of the following:
1. A physical or electronic signature of the copyright owner or of a person authorised to act on their behalf.
2. Identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed.
3. Identification of the material you claim is infringing, with enough information for us to find it, such as the exact link (URL) that was submitted to SaveReelsFast.
4. Your name, postal address, telephone number and email address.
5. A statement that you have a good-faith belief that the use is not authorised by the copyright owner, its agent or the law.
6. A statement, made under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or are authorised to act on their behalf.

sections.heading: What we do with a notice
body: We review complete notices promptly. Where appropriate, we stop processing the specific links identified, so they can no longer be fetched through SaveReelsFast, and we may keep a record of the notice. Incomplete notices may not be actionable, and we may ask you for more information.

sections.heading: Counter-notification
body: If you believe a link was blocked by mistake or misidentification, you may send a counter-notification containing: your signature; identification of the blocked link; a statement under penalty of perjury that you believe in good faith that it was blocked by mistake or misidentification; your name, address, telephone number and email address; and your consent to the jurisdiction of the federal court for your address (or, outside the United States, of the courts where we are located) and to accept service of process from the person who sent the original notice.

sections.heading: Repeat infringement
body: We may block links, sources or networks that are the subject of repeated valid notices, or that abuse the service.

sections.heading: False claims
body: Under 17 U.S.C. § 512(f), anyone who knowingly misrepresents that material is infringing, or that it was removed by mistake, may be liable for damages. Consider seeking legal advice before sending a notice.
